 <div dmwrapped="true" id="dmFirstContainer" class="dmBody u_dmStyle_template_villas dm-home-page" themewaschanged="true"> <div id="allWrapper" class="allWrapper" data-auto="all-wrapper"> <div id="dm_content" class="dmContent" role="main"> <div dm:templateorder="170" class="dmHomeRespTmpl mainBorder dmRespRowsWrapper dmFullRowRespTmpl" id="1716942098"> <div class="u_1243667655 dmRespRow hasBackgroundOverlay dmSectionParallaxNew" style="text-align: center;" id="1243667655"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1173148036"> <div class="dmRespCol small-12 u_1620106714 medium-12 large-12" id="1620106714"> <span id="1479169930"></span> 
 <div class="u_1243236030 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1243236030"> <h1 class="text-align-center"><span style="display:unset;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">The Privacy of a Home</span></h1> 
 <h1 class="text-align-center"><span style="display:unset;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">The Privileges of a Hotel</span></h1> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmRespRow u_1587562612 hasBackgroundOverlay" id="1587562612"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1799009715"> <div class="u_1910550135 dmRespCol small-12 large-7 medium-7" id="1910550135"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1448863439" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <h2><span style="text-shadow: none; display: initial; color: var(--color_7);">Villa Cortez</span></h2> 
</div> 
 <a data-display-type="block" class="u_1577357463 align-center dmButtonLink dmWidget dmWwr default dmOnlyButton dmDefaultGradient flexButton" file="false" href="https://hotels.cloudbeds.com/reservation/5r6IWY" data-element-type="dButtonLinkId" id="1577357463" target="_blank"> <span class="iconBg" aria-hidden="true" id="1265101362"> <span class="icon hasFontIcon icon-star" id="1883901053"></span> 
</span> 
 <span class="text" id="1297807269">CHECK AVAILABILITY</span> 
</a> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1590362958" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1590362958" data-styletopreserve="{" background-image":""}"=""><p class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Villa Cortez is a stunning four-bedroom, four-bathroom resort home just steps from the hotel and beach, with sweeping views of La Ventana Bay and Cerralvo Island from every room. The villa features three king bedrooms and one double-queen bedroom, each with a private bath, plush linens, all-natural bath amenities, ceiling fan, individual A/C, and blackout shades.</span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">The home includes a chef&rsquo;s kitchen with purified reverse-osmosis drinking water, a comfortable living area with a 75&rdquo; TV, and dining for six.</span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Outdoor spaces include a first-floor patio with a hot-and-cold jacuzzi, fireplace, and outdoor shower, plus an expansive rooftop deck with 360-degree views, built-in seating, and a fire pit. Villa Cortez combines spacious indoor and outdoor living for an exceptional Baja stay.</span></p><p><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1895895385 dmRespCol small-12 large-5 medium-5" id="1895895385"> <div class="u_1383436800 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1383436800" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong style="font-weight:bold;display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">Configuration:</strong><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">&nbsp;4 Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms</span></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong style="font-weight:bold;display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">Bed Setup:</strong><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">&nbsp;3 Kings + 1 Double Queen</span></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong style="font-weight:bold;display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">Max Occupancy:</strong><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';"> <span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">Up to 10 Guests</span></span></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong style="font-weight:bold;display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">Minimum Stay:</strong><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';"> <span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">6 Nights</span></span></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div>

 <div class="dmRespRow u_1530765397" id="1530765397"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1596310420"> <div class="u_1702951051 dmRespCol small-12 large-7 medium-7" id="1702951051"> <div class="u_1944837991 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1944837991" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <h2><span style="text-shadow: none; display: initial; color: var(--color_7);"><span style="text-shadow: none; display: initial; color: var(--color_7);">Villa Tres</span> 
</span><span style="text-shadow: none; display: initial; color: var(--color_7); font-style: normal;">Ni&ntilde;os</span></h2> 
</div> 
 <a data-display-type="block" class="u_1904861625 align-center dmButtonLink dmWidget dmWwr default dmOnlyButton dmDefaultGradient flexButton" file="false" href="https://hotels.cloudbeds.com/reservation/5r6IWY" data-element-type="dButtonLinkId" id="1904861625" target="_blank"> <span class="iconBg" aria-hidden="true" id="1005024878"> <span class="icon hasFontIcon icon-star" id="1588631672"></span> 
</span> 
 <span class="text" id="1413640711">CHECK AVAILABILITY</span> 
</a> 
 <div class="u_1455615295 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1455615295" style="text-align: left; display: block; transition: none;"><p class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Villa Tres Ni&ntilde;os is a beautifully appointed three-bedroom, three-bathroom home with panoramic views of La Ventana Bay. The villa features two king bedrooms and one double-queen bedroom, each with a private bath, plush linens, all-natural bath amenities, individual A/C, and blackout shades.</span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Private outdoor spaces include a hot-and-cold jacuzzi, outdoor shower, multiple lounge areas, and secluded outdoor dining, with the convenience of restaurant service from</span> 
</span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">the hotel.</span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">The open-concept second floor features two master suites, a comfortable living area, and a fully equipped kitchen with a gas range, full-size refrigerator, purified reverse-osmosis drinking water, and dining for six. A spacious terrace overlooking the Sea of Cortez is ideal for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or simply taking in the view.</span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1961152409 dmRespCol small-12 large-5 medium-5" id="1961152409"> <div class="u_1570619281 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1570619281" background-image":""}"="" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;"><p><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p><strong style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">Configuration:</strong><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';"> <span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">3 Bedrooms / 3 Bathrooms</span></span></p><p><strong style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">Bed Setup:</strong><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';"> <span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">2 Kings + 1 Double Queen</span></span></p><p><strong style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">Max Occupancy:</strong><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';"> <span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">Up to 8 Guests</span></span></p><p><strong style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">Minimum Stay:</strong><span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';"> <span style="display:initial;font-family:Questrial, 'Questrial Fallback';">6 Nights</span></span></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div>
